Source: petersen:page-0217 ↗ thm:pet-ch5-monodromy-theorem 1. ch5:5.6.9If $U\subset S^n_k$ is an open disc with smooth boundary, there is a diffeomorphism $F:M=S^n_k-\{ p\} \to S^n_k-U$; the pulled-back metric on $M$ has constant curvature but looks poor near the missing point. \end{example}
